coverage_and_limitations.question_count_basis: Eleven meaningful source response units, not a fixed quota. Independent original tasks are separate. Related source periods, inductance endpoints and DC/AC currents remain paired; none is mechanically split.
coverage_and_limitations.multiple_mode_basis: Source 5 has jointly applicable conditional magnitude/reference/data-sufficiency assertions. Source 10 requires the full common-current and source/component phase-relation network. Both use native multiple selections rather than combination-code choices.
coverage_and_limitations.source_5_numeric_blocker: The rotation-axis direction is missing in both original seeds. Perpendicular-axis and 45-degree-axis fixed rotations can satisfy all original numerical givens and initial plane orientation while producing different instantaneous magnitudes. The conventional perpendicular-axis result is explicitly conditional; its polarity is based on a visible selected reference. No unique original unconditional numerical answer is claimed.
coverage_and_limitations.source_8_sign: Only the phase-difference magnitude is determined; neither leading nor lagging is inferred.
coverage_and_limitations.source_9_optional_amplitude: Derived internally but not independently assessed as an extra response unit; the essential DC-current/AC-RMS comparison is retained.
coverage_and_limitations.source_10_drawing_loss: All source and component voltage phases and the common current are recognized using the actual source circuit. Independent drawing, scaling and spatial labeling of the phasor diagram remain unmeasured production skills.
coverage_and_limitations.written_derivation_loss: Choosing a complete result does not demonstrate independently writing its derivation; each source coverage record and question limitation records this format loss.
coverage_and_limitations.new_data_policy: No invented measurements or artwork. The standard vacuum permittivity is explicitly supplied with sufficient precision; chosen terminal/phasor references and conditional rotation assumptions are labeled as conventions or conditions, not source observations.

author_self_check.note: The following are the author's own checks and observations, not an independent reviewer verdict. Internal keys and reproducible derivations remain only in offline drafts.

task_fidelity.evidence: Zero initial current, no energy input, complete decay and all-energy-to-heat conditions retained; result requires q squared divided by twice capacitance.

Plate radius, separation, vacuum approximation, no edges/losses and full epsilon=4 filling retained. Both periods stay paired. Displayed epsilon0 precision now supports the rounding of every alternative.
Both 400/500-Hz endpoint values and direction retained; inverse-square and inverse-linear adjustments give distinguishable ordered pairs.
Single turn, perpendicular axis, all givens and amplitude quantity retained; area conversion, angular-speed conversion and RMS confusion produce concrete alternatives.

All numerical givens retained. Initial maximum flux, instantaneous magnitude and reference-dependent sign remain coupled. Missing axis remains an explicit source blocker rather than being silently filled.
Ideal inductor and source RMS voltage retained; requested current amplitude is distinct from the intermediate RMS value.
Both series reactances retained. Alternatives distinguish opposite, same-direction, perpendicular and ignored-component models.
8 kW average power and both amplitudes retained. Principal magnitude only; no unjustified sign or load-type inference.
Iron-core identity, fixed L and R, 20-V DC, 20-V RMS AC at 400 Hz retained in one paired steady-state response.
Actual source image used. Common current, resistor and source equality, opposite equal reactive voltages and explicit phase conventions assessed together; independent drawing ability is not claimed.
Parallel connection, unchanged inductance and negligible resistance retained; response distinguishes added capacitance from total capacitance and uses the squared frequency ratio.

author_self_check.redundancy: No per-cell or per-arrow split questions. The amplitude calculation and later instantaneous-emf question require different inferences. RMS/amplitude reasoning recurs in the source's distinct energy, inductive, power and RL tasks, without one question giving another question's numeric result.
author_self_check.answer_leakage: Visible subtrees contain source givens, declared conditions, definite mathematical alternatives and no correct-set labels, hidden-source instructions, rationale prose, old exercise interactions or source-number mapping. Numeric options within an item use comparable precision and units. Multiple statements require independent truth judgments, not option-letter combinations.
author_self_check.mathematics: All selected original tasks have independent source-solving records. Every option has an explicit correct derivation or reproducible incorrect procedure in the offline key. Numeric alternatives are distinct; multiple assertions are evaluated under their stated conditions. The discovered English precision defect was frozen and repaired only in its affected question.
author_self_check.bilingual_check: Manually authored actual English and Chinese prose preserve the same concepts, givens, units, response units and declared conditions. Author-owned consistency checks verify IDs, modes, option mathematical expressions and authored truth sets; they do not create questions or establish semantic independence.
author_self_check.pending: A separately authorized reviewer must judge fidelity, coverage losses, data-sufficiency adaptation, leakage and every alternative before any approval. Source 5 cannot be represented as a uniquely solved unconditional numerical original task.
